name: Klue
description:
Connect Klue to Claude to get instant, cited answers based on trusted competitive intelligence and win-loss data.

With Klue’s MCP, sellers get real-time, cited answers on positioning, objections, and what to do next in their specific deals that are in flight. PMMs can analyze win-loss patterns and competitive signals, research voice of buyer, and directly update content in Klue via Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Klue to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Klue to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.app.klue.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Klue MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Klue lists 24 MCP tools, including klue-cards_extract_cards, klue-cards_extract_battlecards, klue-cards_create_card, klue-cards_update_card, klue-cards_delete_cards, klue-cards_create_battlecard, klue-cards_update_battlecard, klue-cards_delete_battlecards, klue-content_search_win_loss_transcripts, klue-content_list_win_loss_transcripts, klue-content_get_win_loss_transcript, and klue-content_search_win_loss_reports.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Klue?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Klue in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Klue requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Klue is developed by Klue Labs. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
